question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘fertile’ in the given sentence.**

The teacher asked, “Wheat is grown in which kind of land – rich, wet, barren and fecund?”
solution: The correct answer is '**Barren**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Fertile**' is '**Barren**' • **Fertile**: (used about land or soil) that plants grow well in. [(ज़मीन या मिट्टी) उपजाऊ] • *Example: The ploughed earth looked rich and dark and **fertile**.* • **Barren**: (used about land or soil) not good enough for plants to grow on. [(भूमि या मिट्टी) पौधों वृद्धि के लिए अनुपयुक्त, ऊसर, बंजर] • *Example: He also wants to use the water to irrigate **barren** desert land.* **Correct Answer:__** *Barren.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Fecund**: able to produce a lot of children, crops, young animals, etc. [(बच्चे, फ़सल आदि) ऊर्वर, बहुफलदायक, उपजाऊ, बहु प्रसव] • **Rich**: having a lot of money or property; not poor. [धनी, अमीरी (धन और संपत्ति वाला); ग़रीब नहीं] • **Wet**: covered in a liquid, especially water. [(पानी या अन्‍य द्रव से) गीला, तर, भीगा हुआ, आर्द्र, नम] 2f:Tefb, The correct answer is** 'The latest assignment was explained to Lana by the manager.'**
